### `circleci testsuite <command>`

A test extension with enriched command documentation.

The CircleCI "testsuite" extension is not installed by default.

Install it with 'circleci extension install testsuite'.

| Flag        | Description            |
| ----------- | ---------------------- |
| `--verbose` | Enable verbose logging |


#### `circleci testsuite do <name> [flags]`

Do a thing with the given name.

| Flag                 | Description                  |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `-p, --parallel int` | Parallel workers (default 4) |
| `--mode fast\|slow`  | How to do it (default fast)  |


**Arguments:**

`<name>` The name to operate on.
